assertion: Deaths jumped 10.8% in 2021 to 43,230, the most since 2005.
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(fatalities) FROM transport.fatal_crashes WHERE "year" IN (2020,2021) GROUP BY "year"

assertion: Deaths in 2025 were the lowest since 2019.
sql: SELECT "year", SUM(fatalities) FROM transport.fatal_crashes WHERE "year" BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024 GROUP BY "year"
